The Finding 3 fix (`_strip_console_log_calls` in services/design_linter.py) replaces a brittle single-shape regex with paren-depth-counting removal — a proper fix. 8/8 shape-coverage tests including nested-parens and non-trailing-semicolon variants pass, and the previously-working shape still works (no regression).

Optional: the founder's note about the 48s task timeout being a possible tuning target was flagged as non-urgent by the founder and was not investigated this round — out of scope, no action needed unless re-raised.
